svg.text: What the red LED is telling you
varies
SD loggers: on for a while after start-up.
Readings are being copied to the card. Wait.
1 s, after 20-40 s
Cellular loggers: one 1-second flash.
It connected and set its clock.
A short light at each reading.
About 2 s on cellular ultrasound loggers.
x5
3 quick flashes, 5 times: something is missing.
SD: no card. Cellular: the XBee is not answering.
x5
2 quick flashes, 5 times: no network time.
Cellular only. Check the SIM, APN and antenna.
nothing
No light at all: no power.
Check the battery, the switch and the FTDI plug.
Press RESET to restart the logger. It does not delete data or settings.
